components.name: ListRow

behaviors: runtime consumers: SurahsRoute surah list, NavDrawer recent-surah rows, and BookmarksList rows. Durable e2e coverage is bounded by the smoke charter; storybook states remain the per-state matrix.

accessibility: rows with onSelect render a native-button select surface spanning the full row when no action slot is present

current-location rows expose aria-current=true; selected state deliberately exposes no aria-selected or aria-pressed because brief section 8 reserves aria-pressed for true toggles and listbox/option semantics belong to composing consumers
selected and current-location rows stay visible state without relying on color alone
touch target at --qar-size-touch-target with visible focus
list semantics such as listbox and option remain owned by composing consumers
forbiddenUses: Do not nest cards inside list rows.
Do not style route-specific row variants in CSS.

container stays a passive group so row activation is not intercepted
forbiddenUses: Do not place primary navigation content in the action area.
